description: One account sends funds to many recipients within a short window.
typical_follow_ups: Confirm whether recipients are employees or vendors.
Compare with the account's historical disbursement pattern.

description: Many senders fund one account within a short window.
typical_follow_ups: Identify the relationship between the senders and the receiver.

description: Funds arrive and leave an account quickly in a similar amount.
typical_follow_ups: Check whether the account is an operating or sweep account.

description: Funds return to the originating account through intermediaries.
typical_follow_ups: Check for documented refunds, reversals or group ownership.
